interpretation_ko: 좋은 앞날과 즐거운 어울림이 있을 길조
interpretation_en: to dream of full pails of milk, is a sign of fair prospects and pleasant associations

cite.original: To dream of full pails of milk, is a sign of fair prospects and pleasant associations.
cite.translation_ko: 젖이 가득한 통을 보는 꿈은, 좋은 앞날과 즐거운 어울림이 있을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: for a young woman to be carrying a pail, denotes household employment

cite.original: For a young woman to be carrying a pail, denotes household employment.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 통을 나르는 꿈은, 집안일을 맡게 될 조짐이다

interpretation_en: to dream that you are in pain, will make sure of your own unhappiness; this dream foretells useless regrets over some trivial transaction

cite.original: To dream that you are in pain, will make sure of your own unhappiness. This dream foretells useless regrets over some trivial transaction.
cite.translation_ko: 제가 아파하는 꿈은, 스스로 불행해질 것을 다짐하는 것과 같다. 하찮은 일에 부질없는 후회만 남을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: to see others in pain, warns you that you are making mistakes in your life

cite.original: To see others in pain, warns you that you are making mistakes in your life.
cite.translation_ko: 남이 아파하는 것을 보는 꿈은, 살아가며 잘못을 저지르고 있다는 경고다

interpretation_en: to see newly painted houses in dreams, foretells that you will succeed with some devised plan

cite.original: To see newly painted houses in dreams, foretells that you will succeed with some devised plan.
cite.translation_ko: 새로 페인트칠한 집을 보는 꿈은, 꾸민 계획이 성공할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: to have paint on your clothing, you will be made unhappy by the thoughtless criticisms of others

cite.original: To have paint on your clothing, you will be made unhappy by the thoughtless criticisms of others.
cite.translation_ko: 옷에 페인트가 묻는 꿈은, 남의 무심한 비판으로 언짢을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: to dream that you use the brush yourself, denotes that you will be well pleased with your present occupation

cite.original: To dream that you use the brush yourself, denotes that you will be well pleased with your present occupation.
cite.translation_ko: 스스로 붓을 쥐고 칠하는 꿈은, 지금 하는 일에 흡족할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 벗들이 거짓된 태도를 보이고 즐거움도 헛될 흉조
interpretation_en: to dream of seeing beautiful paintings, denotes that friends will assume false positions towards you, and you will find that pleasure is illusive

cite.original: To dream of seeing beautiful paintings, denotes that friends will assume false positions towards you, and you will find that pleasure is illusive.
cite.translation_ko: 아름다운 그림들을 보는 꿈은, 벗들이 거짓된 태도를 보이고 즐거움도 헛될 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 정인이 마음을 다른 이에게 옮겨 속게 될 흉조
interpretation_en: for a young woman to dream of painting a picture, she will be deceived in her lover, as he will transfer his love to another

cite.original: For a young woman to dream of painting a picture, she will be deceived in her lover, as he will transfer his love to another.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 그림을 그리는 꿈은, 정인이 마음을 다른 이에게 옮겨 속게 될 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 앞날이 밝아지고 새로운 위엄을 갖추게 될 길조
interpretation_en: wandering through a palace and noting its grandeur, signifies that your prospects are growing brighter and you will assume new dignity

cite.original: Wandering through a palace and noting its grandeur, signifies that your prospects are growing brighter and you will assume new dignity.
cite.translation_ko: 궁궐을 거닐며 그 웅장함에 감탄하는 꿈은, 앞날이 밝아지고 새로운 위엄을 갖추게 될 조짐이다

context: 신사 숙녀들이 춤추고 담소하는 것을 보고 들음
interpretation_ko: 이롭고 즐거운 어울림에 들게 될 길조
interpretation_en: to see and hear fine ladies and men dancing and conversing, denotes that you will engage in profitable and pleasing associations

cite.original: To see and hear fine ladies and men dancing and conversing, denotes that you will engage in profitable and pleasing associations.
cite.translation_ko: 신사 숙녀들이 춤추고 담소하는 것을 보고 듣는 꿈은, 이롭고 즐거운 어울림에 들게 될 조짐이다

context: 형편이 넉넉지 않은 처녀가 잔치에 대등하게 낌
interpretation_ko: 혼인이나 친척의 후함으로 살림이 나아질 길조
interpretation_en: for a young woman of moderate means to dream that she is a participant in the entertainment, and of equal social standing with others, is a sign of her advancement through marriage, or the generosity of relatives

cite.original: For a young woman of moderate means to dream that she is a participant in the entertainment, and of equal social standing with others, is a sign of her advancement through marriage, or the generosity of relatives.
cite.translation_ko: 형편이 넉넉지 않은 처녀가 잔치에 남들과 대등하게 끼는 꿈은, 혼인이나 친척의 후함으로 살림이 나아질 조짐이다

context: 형편이 어려운 처녀에게 이 꿈이 속임수처럼 다가옴
interpretation_ko: 게으르고 헛된 몽상이 빚어낸 속기 쉬운 꿈이라는 흉조
interpretation_en: this is often a very deceitful and misleading dream to the young woman of humble circumstances; as it is generally induced in such cases by the unhealthy day dreams of her idle, empty brain

cite.original: This is often a very deceitful and misleading dream to the young woman of humble circumstances; as it is generally induced in such cases by the unhealthy day dreams of her idle, empty brain.
cite.translation_ko: 형편이 어려운 처녀에게는 이 꿈이 자주 속임수처럼 다가온다. 게으르고 헛된 몽상이 빚어낸 것이기 때문이다

interpretation_ko: 낯선 이를 기쁘게 하려 잘 세운 계획을 바꾸다 제 이익을 해칠 흉조
interpretation_en: to dream of the palisades, denotes that you will alter well-formed plans to please strangers, and by so doing, you will impair your own interests

cite.original: To dream of the palisades, denotes that you will alter well-formed plans to please strangers, and by so doing, you will impair your own interests.
cite.translation_ko: 말뚝 울타리 꿈은, 낯선 이를 기쁘게 하려 잘 세운 계획을 바꾸다 제 이익을 해칠 조짐이다
